output.reason: Evidence states that the pre-payment charge directions under paragraph 261 apply to loans “sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026,” and for dual/special rate loans it depends on whether the loan is on floating rate at the time of pre-payment (para 261(4)). However, the evidence does not establish this for all floating-rate cases regardless of loan purpose; for example, para 261(1) specifically restricts pre-payment charges only for floating rate loans granted for purposes other than “business to individuals.” Therefore the claim is only partially supported.
